name: signalk-pypilot-newui
description: Signal K friendly UI for the pypilot autopilot, with first-class Signal K paths and Simple Switches so any downstream Signal K client can drive or monitor the pilot. Touch-first mobile visor + full pypilot data (servo, gains, calibration, tack, warnings). Coexists with pypilot-autopilot-provider.

screenshots.title: Control - compass rose with heading, AWA/TWA wind arrows, hull-fixed sailing wedges, configurable corner tiles and an AIS collision target on the compass ring
Chartplotter integrated - double-tap the rose to open Freeboard-SK inside it, with AIS targets and the anchor circle; the autopilot buttons stay reachable. Needs a Signal K chart provider
AnchorWatch Pro (signalk-mareas-ihm) anchor-watch visor opened inside the rose: swing circles, track, wind gusts, depth and tide
Tide at a glance - tide curve of the nearest station with current height, trend, next high / low water and coefficient (with AnchorWatch Pro)
Mode and profile picker - compass, GPS, apparent and true wind plus the Head to wind (hoist sail) and Head downwind (strike sail) manoeuvres
Tune - PID gains per pilot / profile with plain-language help, locked by default, fine-step buttons and reset to baseline
Logbook - auto-recorded trip with speed-coloured track, gust / peak SOG / low voltage / tack markers and a SOG vs AWS chart
Tack history - every tack with speed retention and recovery time, best retention and fastest recovery highlighted
